A '''smithing trim color''' is the pack's only armor trim material; ingots and gems no longer work.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/trim_materials.json}}</ref> See [[Trims]].

== Obtaining ==
Each is crafted from 7 iron ingots, a steel alloy and a coloring ingredient in the center, a block or an alloy (see [[Trims]]).
